thread:
matt c: Heads-up — trying to land PR #10412 before the deploy freeze at 00:00 UTC. CI failing on one integration test that looks flaky, not related to my change. Can someone kick a rerun or advise rebase window?

ci-bot: Build 10412 — integration-tests — FAILED (timeout). Logs: `tests/integration/test_ingest.py::test_batch_retry` timeout after 5m. ⏱️

sara li: Link the PR? I can trigger a rerun but oncall needs to confirm quota for manual reruns this late in the cycle. @eng-oncall can you confirm?

matt c: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/10412 — I only changed batching logic in serving runtime, not integration surface. I rebased to main a few mins ago. If you need a rebase window I can do another.

julia t: I can give this a look. If the failure is flaky we should rerun once; if it still flakes I'll open a tiny test fix PR. @sara li — feel free to rerun. Also suggest adding `ci:retry` label so release automation knows it's being actively retried.

ci-bot: Command received: `/ci rerun 10412 integration-tests` — queued.

sara li: Manually kicked the integration job. Tagging @eng-oncall for quota — please confirm you accept the manual job.

eng-oncall: Confirmed — we have quota for one manual rerun. Proceeding.

ci-bot: Rerun started (job id 10412-2).

matt c: thanks — I'm around for the next hour if anything else pops. If this still fails I can revert the non-critical refactor to unblock the merge.

ci-bot: Rerun finished — integration-tests PASSED, unit-tests FAILED (1 flaky assertion in `test_cache_eviction`). See logs: `AssertionError: cache length expected 64 but got 63` — flaky pattern seen before.

julia t: Great, integration is green. Unit flake is known, i'll slap a retry/flake-fix PR in the morning. Given deploy freeze at 00:00 UTC, we have a small window: if unit tests pass on rerun within next 20m we can merge; otherwise defer to next rebase window. Thoughts?

sara li: Ops: release bot still enforces freeze, but manual merges allowed if all CI green and @release-leads sign off. @julia t can you be release lead for this one?

julia t: I can sign off. Requesting one more quick unit rerun — matt, can you trigger `/ci rerun 10412 unit-tests` or I can do it.

matt c: done: `/ci rerun 10412 unit-tests` — watching.

ci-bot: Unit-tests rerun queued.

ci-bot: Unit-tests rerun finished — PASSED. All checks green.

julia t: I approve and sign off for merge despite freeze — condition: add `canary=true` to the rollout so we can rollback quickly if something odd appears in canary.

sara li: Noted. I'll handle the merge and canary kickoff. Merging now. :merge:

ci-bot: Merge completed: PR #10412 merged into main by sara li. Canary rollout started to 5% traffic.

matt c: Thank you all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Will follow up tomorrow with the flake fix PR for `test_cache_eviction`.

julia t: Thanks — good call to canary it. If we see any regressions I'll trigger rollback.

eng-oncall: Monitoring canary metrics for 30m window. Ping here if anything spikes.

matt c: Will do. :thumbsup:
